newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stock futures take fx easing in stride.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stock futures take fx easing in stride.

text.p: 0700 GMT - Early South African equity futures steady to firmer, shrugging off weakness in rand which seen softening further as limited easing of foreign exchange controls on private individuals takes effect on Tuesday.

* Dealers say futures and equity market already discounted expected offshore flows from 200,000 rand each individual can investment offshore. General expectation that not more than 3-5 bln rand will flow out.
* Futures looking ahead to release of gold and foreign exchange reserves later, which Reuters poll sees up a robust three billion rand.
* Gold contracts weathering ailing bullion which drops another dollar from late Monday to trade at $333.60/334.10.
* Spot market seen opening weaker after pushed at close Monday to inflate books at end of unit trust quarter. Will open arbitrage opportunities, which may lift stocks off lows.
* September all-share contract last at 6,790/820 from 6,971, the near-month industrial at 8,587/605 from 8,579 and goldi at 650/80 from 670 settlement.
